title: The three of them
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Thursday. Gully's uncle's dock. The three of them on it for the last time until 2002. The uncle in the lawn chair with the oxygen line. Nobody says it's the last time; the strip draws it like it is.

panels.composition: The dock, dusk, rain easing. GULLY, CHLOE, WOOD at the end of it, legs over. The UNCLE in the lawn chair by the shack with the oxygen line. BARNABY between the three.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, three teenagers sitting at the end of a wooden dock at dusk with their legs over the water and a small dog between them, an old man in a lawn chair with an oxygen line by a shingle shack behind, rain easing
image.notes: The uncle's last appearance with all three. He dies Feb 2001, off-page.

panels.composition: Gully, with the thermos. Pouring three.

balloons.text: Uncle says it's the last good coffee till spring.

panels.composition: Chloe, between them, looking at the water. Wood looking at the water. Gully looking at both of them.
